objs.name: document
objs.description: Paperless managed item whose properties, content, versions, validity, distribution, authorizations and lifecycle are described in the system.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected corresponding document type for a document.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number_per_type
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name composed by default from abbreviation, number per type and title.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document and used in lifecycle/workflow status.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorizations and registered author.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorizations for review.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorizations for release.

attributes.name: releaser_incl._translation
attributes.description: Attribute mentioned for setting authorizations upon reactivation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity period count starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined for each document type and used to calculate valid until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration defined for each document type for archiving.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects existing user groups and persons for email notification when next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects workflow task distribution when next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type documenting regulations and instructions, especially locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting special detailed work steps, often relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File that can be uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Released and published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorization assignment, distribution and role-related access.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented in the system for a user group.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual user/person assigned authorizations, workflow roles or distribution.

attributes.name: read_authorization
attributes.description: Read authorization assigned through distribution or document control.

attributes.name: write_permission
attributes.description: Write permission received when assigned to author, reviewer or releaser roles.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned specifically to documents for read and change rights.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role implemented in DHC VISION to provide users with functions according to their area of application.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role in brackets.

objs.name: document_reader
objs.description: Role whose readers can only view approved objects.

objs.name: document_author
objs.description: Role whose users are offered in author or co-author selection lists and can create document types and change proposals.

objs.name: document_checker
objs.description: Role whose reviewers check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: document_approver
objs.description: Role whose releasers are responsible for document and content and decide distribution to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role that can translate released content into another language and cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document that can be created without affecting content or version history and is managed for a document.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created for a selected document to invalidate documents.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for re-validating invalidated documents.

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Creator of the request for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document by assigning user groups or persons who are automatically informed about release.

attributes.name: distribution_by_e_mail
attributes.description: Distribution type where assigned users are informed by email notification when a new document version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Distribution type where assigned persons and users are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement requested and documented for distribution.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Master data object with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Master data object with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Master data object with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data such as IT applications with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of master data with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter available for reports.

attributes.name: selection_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria available for reports.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard filled with information by defining distribution groups in the distribution list.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released documents.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version required to be in released state before translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which authorized readers see the corresponding released language version.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: New documents are created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: One or more document templates can be selected when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: A pure object cover can be created.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Document properties and metadata are maintained.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Document content is edited with an editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Once the document has been saved, it is converted to PDF.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Changes to released documents result in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participants
evts.description: Participants in the release process are assigned via document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be added to each document.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released and published directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachments can be added to each document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modification of attachments triggers a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archiving of attachments triggers a new version and archived attachments are archived with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Author-right users can create change proposals for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The approval process is initiated and the 3-step release process is started.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creator workflow step.

evts.name: complete_review_task
evts.description: Reviewers complete review tasks for checking the document.

evts.name: complete_release_task
evts.description: Releasers complete release tasks to finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: A rejection during review or release cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system informs involved users by e-mail notifications.

evts.name: document_electronic_signature
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: If a valid and released document is revised, a new version is automatically created in editing status.

evts.name: create_new_document_version
evts.description: A new version of the document is automatically created for specified changes or scheduled change proposals.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal_implementation
evts.description: If a change proposal is scheduled for implementation, a new document version is created.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: A request for validity extension is created by the system before validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declaring additional validity deletes the request and updates the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: The validity extension process is automatically terminated when a revised new version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Users with write access can create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: After attaching the request for AKS, the workflow for processing the request is started automatically.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: After declaration of Out of force, the document is invalidated, archived and rights are revoked except for archive group.

evts.name: delete_edited_versions
evts.description: Existing edited versions are deleted after Out of force is declared.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, documents are physically deleted.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created and the corresponding document is selected for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is started automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation and a new version is created.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Distribution lists are maintained for each document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: release_new_document_version
evts.description: When a new document version is released, distribution notifications or acknowledgement requests occur.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users in distribution for acknowledgement are automatically requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipients actively confirm acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: notify_all_acknowledgements_confirmed
evts.description: The author team receives a notification when all maintained persons have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Dashboards are filled with information by defining distribution groups in distribution lists.

evts.name: run_report
evts.description: Role-specific evaluation reports provide evaluations according to selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released content is translated into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is released and becomes visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.

evts.name: create_local_document_addition
evts.description: A new document is created in the client for a local addition and references the original document.
